firstHeading: Where can I find the best price for a tennis racket?
secondHeading: RacketTracker is the solution for you!
firstText: This tracker shows you the price of tennis rackets in several online stores in order for you to find the best deal possible!
stepperDesc1: Start by choosing one of the brands you are interested in to help filter the search.
stepperDesc2: In the next step go by the list of rackets available for that brand and choose the one that you want.
stepperDesc3: After selecting the racket you want you are immediately transported to the online store that posted that offer, where you can complete the purchase.
racketsDesc1: Choose a brand in order to start looking for the perfect racket for you!
racketsDesc2: Then search for the name of the racket to see the several options available to you!
